title: Hold a permit to dump material at sea
what: Dumping controlled material at sea, or loading it for dumping, needs a permit.

sources.title: Environment Protection (Sea Dumping) Act 1981
sources.quote: 10A Dumping of controlled material (1) A person commits an offence against this section if, otherwise than in accordance with a permit, the person: (a) dumps controlled material into Australian waters from any vessel, aircraft or platform;

reach.condition: if it dumps or loads controlled material for dumping at sea
